name: unet50_ilp_calib_div_gap5_short10
notes: short-track filter min_track_len 6 to 10, one variable vs exp 9. NO CV AND CANNOT HAVE ONE, same reason as exps 4 to 9: the pack trained on 180 of our 199 videos. On the pack's held-out 19 the competition total is 0.9125 against 0.9043 for exp 9, +0.0082, paired bootstrap 95% CI [+0.0042,+0.0125], P(>0)=1.000, both embryos positive. Second change in this competition to satisfy the repo's own rule outright, after the gap radius. The 6 was inherited from the public 0.927 notebook and had never been screened as a value; the full curve is 4=0.8975, 5=0.9010, 6=0.9043, 7=0.9067, 8=0.9090, 10=0.9125, 12=0.9128, 16=0.9037, 20=0.8719, 30=0.7713. 10 rather than 12 because the two are indistinguishable on the point estimate, 10 has the tighter interval, and the curve falls off a cliff above 12, so being one notch low costs far less than being one notch high. MECHANISM IS THE NODE COUNT TERM, NOT THE EDGE TERM: raw Jaccard moves only 0.9118 to 0.9130 while the weighted node ratio falls from +0.148 to +0.071. adj_J = max(0, J * (1 - 0.1 * (N_pred - N_true) / N_true)) has no upper cap, so under-predicting nodes multiplies the Jaccard by more than one. The filter removes 26,632 nodes of 376,359 and costs 41 true positive edges of 12,393. PREDICTION RECORDED BEFORE THE SCORE: this should transfer at or above face value rather than at the calibration chain's 86%, because the node count term is where NOTES.md already records the held-out 19 as under-reading (exp 6 was +0.0006 local and +0.005 LB) and because the step has no learned parameters. A flat or negative move would say the hidden embryo's tracks are fragmented enough that 10 cuts real track. Same screen found prune_isolated, gap_reuse_um and single_parent all inert inside the finished chain, scoring identically to exp 9; left in place because removing them is a second variable. Kernel cell-tracking-inference-short10 v1 pushed, not yet run. LB 0.878 to 0.884, +0.006, the largest single-step gain since the calibration chain. THE RECORDED PREDICTION WAS WRONG: it said transfer at or above face value and the transfer was about 73%, +0.006 against a local +0.0082, and no reading of the rounding reaches 100%. The reasoning rested on one observation, exp 6's +0.0006 local against +0.005 LB, whose numerator this file had already called noise; a ratio with a noise numerator is not a calibration. The falsification test that was named in advance, a flat or negative move meaning 10 cuts real track on an unseen embryo, did NOT fire, so the setting stands and there is no case for retreating to 7. The change was right and the forecast of its size was too optimistic.

name: unet50_ilp_calib_div_gap5_short10_divsym
notes: two structural gates on the safe-division rule, symmetry >= 0.6 and both daughters surviving 3 frames, one variable vs exp 10. NO CV AND CANNOT HAVE ONE, same reason as exps 4 to 10. On the pack's held-out 19 the competition total is 0.9201 against 0.9125 for exp 10, +0.0076, paired bootstrap 95% CI [-0.0014,+0.0156], P(>0)=0.951, both embryos positive. INCONCLUSIVE BY THE REPO'S RULE because the interval crosses zero, and submitted anyway for the reason recorded on 2026-08-29 and confirmed on 2026-08-31: the held-out 19 contain 19 ground truth divisions in total so the division Jaccard has a denominator of 19, while the public split is about 58 videos. For this one term the leaderboard is the better instrument, and last time that argument was made the change came back at +0.011 against a local +0.0049. DIAGNOSIS: every gate the rule had was a distance, and the dominant false fork is distance-blind. It is a neighbouring cell whose own parent link was missed; it sits near the track, continues and diverges, so it passes every existing test. It does not sit opposite the real child. A parent lies near the midpoint of its own daughters and nowhere near the midpoint of its child and an unrelated neighbour. Symmetry is the ratio of the shorter to the longer parent-to-daughter arm and it is the gate the public rule does not have. Alone it cuts false forks 31 to 11 while keeping all three true ones. Division counts 3tp/10fp/16fn against 3/31/16, divJ 0.1034 against 0.0600. The edge term improves too, adj_J 0.9065 to 0.9098, because a false fork costs an edge and a node as well as a division. Chose 3-frame persistence over 5-frame (0.9201 vs 0.9208, noise) and dropped the cosine gate (bit- identical division counts, so symmetry subsumes it): both choices to the conservative side, since the hidden embryo's graph is more fragmented than this set and both alternatives are less forgiving of fragmentation. TWO IDEAS MEASURED AND REJECTED IN THE SAME SESSION, neither in this config: pricing divisions in the ILP is worse at every weight from 0.9 to 0.2, monotonically, -0.0067 to -0.0814, because recall improves 16fn to 7fn while false forks go 10 to 803 and the extra forks re-admit nodes the track filter had removed; and the dangling-branch filter is inert here, moving 1,063 nodes of 347,869 and scoring within noise at every length from 3 to 10.
